editor.title: libreoffice.1
editor.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Collabora Online]
editor.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Collabora Online Editor for office documents]

global_param.name: LIBREOFFICE_CODE_VERSION
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Code Version]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Some URLs differ between old versions (Version lower than 6) and more recent versions (Version greater than 21+)]

global_param.name: LIBREOFFICE_SSL_SKIP_VERIFY
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Skip Certificate Verification]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Use TLS without validating the certificate]

global_param.name: LIBREOFFICE_INTERNAL_CELLS_BASE_URL
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Base URL for the Cells backend from the LibreOffice backend]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Base URL for the Cells backend from the LibreOffice backend]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_PRINT
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Disable Print]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Hide the print button and disable printing for all users in Collabora Online]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_EXPORT
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Disable Export / Download As]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Hide the export menu and disable downloading for all users in Collabora Online]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_SAVE
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Disable Save / Save As]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Hide the save button and block Save As for all users in Collabora Online]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_COPY
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Disable Copy]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Block copying document content to external apps (internal copy/paste still works)]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_MODE
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Default Access Mode]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Downgrade the opening mode for all users: edit, comment-only, or read-only]

global_param.name: COLLABORA_DISABLE_REPAIR
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Hide Repair Button]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Hide the Repair document button in Collabora]
